g.text: VDA9 3×3 · crossattn1 · red cue and valid change at S1

Rows preserve query patches; columns are logical timesteps. S1 is bordered at every time. Green marks cue onset and orange marks change onset. Cross-attention image and memory keys are paired and summed by spatial location. Uniform attention = 0.111.
